experimental_design: Fifty-six isolates arranged into nested synthetic communities; 388 focal taxon effects were reported across communities containing two to eight isolates
interaction_outcome: Signed change in focal taxon abundance after adding one isolate; 126 positive and 262 negative observations
neutral_status: No experimentally defined neutral class; a prespecified uncertainty rule would be required
abundance_source: The interaction outcome is calculated from the same community abundance measurements that would supply network scores
public_access: Article and supplemental files are public through the University of Chicago repository
main_risk: Outcome leakage and repeated observations that share isolates and nested communities
decision: Conditional for studying transfer of interaction sign; exclude from the primary independent benchmark

experimental_design: Eight soil isolates studied in pair cultures under low and high nutrient conditions; natural soil microbiotas were followed separately
interaction_outcome: Pair competition and coexistence outcomes under nutrient treatments
neutral_status: No suitable positive versus tested-neutral definition identified
abundance_source: The complex abundance series contain environmental taxa; only some taxa match the eight isolates used in pair experiments
public_access: Article and associated Dryad record are public
main_risk: The organisms in the abundance and pair experiments do not form one aligned taxon set
decision: Reject for the primary calibration analysis

experimental_design: All 127 subsets of a seven-strain synthetic community were assembled on duckweed
interaction_outcome: Continuous directed interaction coefficients calculated from changes in strain abundance; 1,344 effects across community compositions
neutral_status: No direct tested-neutral class; uncertainty intervals could define an exploratory neutral group
abundance_source: CFU measurements from the subset cultures generate both the interaction coefficients and any abundance table used for network inference
public_access: Raw CFU counts are in Dataset S1; code and intermediate files are public on Zenodo
main_risk: Outcome leakage, only 21 unique undirected taxon pairs, and many effects from the same seven strains
decision: Conditional mechanistic sensitivity analysis; unsuitable as the primary independent benchmark

experimental_design: Hundreds of pairwise competitions among members of 12 stable enrichment communities, each containing three to ten species
interaction_outcome: Coexistence or competitive exclusion after serial pair competition
neutral_status: No positive, negative, and neutral interaction classes; the endpoint is coexistence
abundance_source: Pair outcomes are derived from pair abundance trajectories; multispecies communities provide few repeated abundance observations for static network fitting
public_access: A 28.67 MB data archive and README are public on Dryad; the optional analysis pipeline is 44.05 GB
main_risk: Outcome leakage for pair data, small separate systems, and an endpoint that differs from interaction support
decision: Exclude from primary binary calibration; retain only as an auxiliary coexistence test if a separate score source is established
